title: Northbeam TechWorks Bench Note: Diagnostic Charges Credited Against a Rebill
content:
A diagnostic charge standing on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job may be credited against the figure being rebilled on it.

**Where the diagnostic fees standing on the job are more than the figure being rebilled**, the figure being rebilled is credited in full, so nothing is left to bill.

**Where a diagnostic fee stands on the job and every diagnosis recorded on it found a fault**, the diagnostic fees standing on the job are credited in full.

**Where neither situation holds**, nothing is credited for a diagnostic fee.

## The comparisons side by side

| The diagnostic fees standing on the job | What the diagnoses recorded found | Credited |
| --- | --- | --- |
| more than the figure being rebilled | any | the figure being rebilled, in full |
| at or below the figure being rebilled, and above nothing | every one of them found a fault | the diagnostic fees standing on the job |
| at or below the figure being rebilled, and above nothing | at least one found no fault | nothing |
| nothing | any | nothing |

The first comparison is a strict one: diagnostic fees exactly equal to the figure being rebilled are not more than it, so the second reading is the one that applies to them.

## Points of judgement

**A job carrying a diagnostic fee and no diagnosis at all.** No diagnosis recorded on the job found no fault, so the second reading holds and the diagnostic fees standing on the job are credited in full.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

**A diagnostic fee larger than the figure being rebilled.** The figure being rebilled is 60.00 USD and diagnostic fees of 79.00 USD stand on the job. The figure being rebilled is credited in full, so nothing is left to bill on the line.

**A diagnostic fee smaller than the figure being rebilled, every diagnosis finding a fault.** The figure being rebilled is 297.50 USD and a diagnostic fee of 79.00 USD stands on a job whose two recorded diagnoses each found a fault. 79.00 USD is credited.

**The same job, one diagnosis finding no fault.** Nothing is credited for a diagnostic fee.
